evidence: The (001), (002) and (101) peaks for a hexagonal package of Ru appeared for all types of films. A general difference was observed, however, between PECVD/PEALD Ru-C and PVD Ru films, namely that the (001) diffraction peak was the strongest peak within the spectrum of PECVD/PEALD Ru-C films, whereas in the case of PVD Ru the (002) Peak was most pronounced.
